{{translated title|rom}} [[File:Yosaku.png|thumb|right|250px|Yosaku]] (Japanese: '''ヨサク''' ''Yosaku'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP145|A Farfetch'd Tale]]''. Living in the [[Ilex Forest]], Yosaku makes [[Charcoal]] and provides it to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who are passing through. He is helped out by {{OBP|Sylvester|EP145}} (his employee in the Japanese version, his son in the English dub), who attempted to seek Yosaku's help when his {{p|Farfetch'd}} refused to listen to him. However, Yosaku simply told Sylvester that he should find and train the Farfetch'd on his own. He was also seen giving a large amount of Charcoal to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} after they had saved Sylvester's Farfetch'd and helped Sylvester to command it correctly. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Yosaku's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Magmar |type1=Fire |img=Yosaku Magmar.png |epnum=EP145 |epname=A Farfetch'd Tale |vajp= |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Magmar}} was briefly seen helping Yosaku make [[Charcoal]] with its flames.
